messages:
sam_cs: Heads-up: escalation from ACME Corp — user j.doe@acme.com lost Admin role after the latest Okta SCIM sync. Customer says they didn’t remove group membership. Investigating SCIM events and sharing here for triage.

anna_se: Can you paste the SCIM payload and any Okta member IDs? Also need the customer org and the affected user id.

sam_cs: Org: org-987654, user: j.doe@acme.com, user_id: U-2321
SCIM event from our logs: 
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/U-2321
Payload: {
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "replace",
    "path": "members",
    "value": [{
      "value": "svc-12345",
      "display": "svc-app@acme.com",
      "type": "service"
    }]
  }]
}
```
We then see the deprovision reconciliation remove the role mapping (excerpt):
```
2026-03-10T15:02:01Z INFO  scim: apply_patch user=U-2321 op=replace path=members
2026-03-10T15:02:01Z WARN  scim: externalId collision: new member externalId=svc-12345 existingId=svc-12345
2026-03-10T15:02:02Z INFO  auth: remove_role user=U-2321 role=org-admin by=scim-sync
```
Customer reports svc-app is a service account they re-provisioned in Okta; seems like the service account object collided with the user's membership entry.

jordan_infra: @sam_cs thanks — this looks like an externalId collision when Okta pushed a service-account member object that replaced the user's member entry in the group's members array. Likely repro: 
1) Create service account in Okta with email svc-app@acme.com (externalId SVC-12345)
2) Okta group push issues SCIM PATCH that touches group.members and includes the service account object
3) Our mapper matches member objects by externalId and ends up replacing the user->member mapping with the service account object
4) Role reconciliation sees the user no longer in the admin group and removes org-admin
Repro steps to run in staging (okta-cli example):
```
okta scim PATCH /Groups/G-999/members --data @members.json
# members.json contains the same members array as the payload above
```
I'll file an infra ticket to run this against staging and capture a deterministic trace.

alex_sre: Short-term remediation for the customer: manually re-add the role via Console > Org > Members -> assign org-admin back to j.doe@acme.com.
Also advise the Okta admin to stop re-using externalId values between service accounts and user objects. I can run a backfill script if they want — sample SQL: 
```
UPDATE user_roles SET role='org-admin' WHERE user_email='j.doe@acme.com' AND org_id='org-987654';
```
I'll coordinate with CS for a maintenance window to run the backfill if they approve.

sam_cs: Customer asked for a permanent fix — can engineering change the SCIM handler to avoid replacing memberships when incoming member.type == 'service' AND externalId collides with an existing user? That way a service account push won't drop real user memberships. @jordan_infra any objections?

jordan_infra: No objections. We should add a guard: when patching members, if incoming.member.type == 'service' and externalId matches an existing user/member, treat it as add-only or ignore the replace. Will file ENG-PLAT-4823 and add unit + integration tests. Also add an audit flag so operators can see ignored collisions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started CI run for ENG-PLAT-4823 branch on staging at 2026-03-11T02:10:00Z :rocket:

sam_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll update the customer with the short-term steps and ETA for the engineering change. Opening formal support ticket with the log excerpts and the repro steps above.
